journal_lines: Heard it before I saw it. Put it down.
Shambling thing in the corridor. Gone.
Smelled it first. Dealt with it.
Slow as a tired river, and twice as patient. Patience does not save the patient.
It wore cloth it had once been proud of. The cloth remembered. The thing did not.
A face that had been a face. Did not look long.
Groaned as it fell. The same groan as before. The same groan as always.
Found me by smell. I am told I smell like food.
Two of them. Then one. Then none.
Dragged itself the last few paces. Did the same on the way down.
A hunger that did not understand it was no longer hungry.
